targets.doc/signature_limit.md:
# Signature limit

A single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only, as per the CFO directive of 1 July 2026. This directive takes precedence where it differs from the procurement policy.

The procurement policy states that a single signature suffices for purchases up to two thousand (2000) EUR.

However, the CFO directive overrides this policy until further notice.

[[cite:obs-55f345dd82dc0a69957793d2602caee070e3f0c1 "Until further notice a single signature suffices for purchases up to one thousand (1000) EUR only."]]
